R1_irregular_localised.criterion: referee error peaks > 20% at ka=2.58 on some magnitude while every probe at |ka-2.58| >= 0.08 stays < 10% on that magnitude

R2_irregular_mesh_dependent.criterion: the pole ka moves by >= 0.04 (one probe spacing, 0.04) between the 1024 and 4096 panel referee meshes

R3_referee_scaled_drift.criterion: |dA|/(rho*nabla), |dB|/(rho*omega*nabla) <= 0.01 for the 1024 -> 4096 panel lidless referee ladder at every ka

R4_in_band_three_way.criterion: ka = 1.0, 2.0: TensorBEM(1024) and capytaine(4096) within 5% of Hulme on all four magnitudes and of each other

L1a_lid_removes_pole.criterion: lid-closed B33 referee error over ka in {2.54,2.58,2.62} at 4096 panels < 10% (lidless: up to 108 %)

L2_lid_referee_accuracy.declared_in: referee_robustness_merge.py (this merge step; new gate, justified because L1a makes the lid arm the usable referee)
L2_lid_referee_accuracy.criterion: lid-closed capytaine (4096 panels) within 3% of the Hulme series on all four magnitudes, every ka in the arm

L2b_lid_referee_scaled_drift.criterion: lid-closed referee 1024 -> 4096 panel drift in the physical scale |dA|/(rho*nabla), |dB|/(rho*omega*nabla) <= 0.01
